bio.text: Lyman Hoffman, a Democrat from Bethel, represents District S in the Alaska Senate and has served in the Alaska Legislature since 1987, in the House and the Senate, according to the Alaska Legislature.
The legislative biography says Hoffman was born in Bethel on February 13, 1950, attended the University of Alaska studying business administration, and is a businessman and fisherman.
Hoffman was city manager of Bethel from 1977 to 1985, according to the same biography.
